set.body: Independent PHRF29 review found TrialBandedWorkSnapshot counters charged only after successful reference construction/solves; failed continuous jets and partial reference work disappear. Own TrialBanded.scala plus bounded new shared work-receipt suite only. Add distinct attempted/failure accounting at actual banded factor and solve entry points, including RHS counts, failed release/reference construction, rejected decoder candidates and exact-coordinate final readout. Preserve existing field meanings and successful counters, numerical equations and iteration order. Distinguish immutable node-bank setup from per-worker response work; shared setup must not be multiplied by workers. No generic solver family or benchmark-only fabricated counters. Independent regression for a continuous-shape release rank failure AFTER factor/derivative solves must retain actual attempted counts; success counts unchanged; fresh/shared workers do not double-count setup. Shared JVM+JS tests and TrialBanded laws, warning-clean compile. Required before full attempted-work or B0 throughput qualification; no scientific/performance claim from counters alone.
set.title: Record attempted TrialBanded factors and solves, including rejected profile candidates
